profile.name: Nan Hu
profile.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
profile.summary: I am a UMD/JIFSAN postdoctoral research associate developing genomic and computational approaches for understanding plant diversity, from willow sex chromosome evolution to mixed-sample plant DNA identification.
profile.researchStatement: My research connects evolutionary genomics with applied bioinformatics. I use target sequencing, population genomics, phylogenetic inference, and reproducible pipelines to study how plant genomes change and how genome-scale data can improve species identification, biodiversity monitoring, and botanical research.
profile.cvIntro: Postdoctoral Research Associate at JIFSAN / University of Maryland, working on plant genomics, mixed plant DNA identification, and computational tools for biodiversity research.

stats.label: Current Role

researchAreas.title: Mixed Plant DNA Identification
researchAreas.summary: I develop pipelines for identifying species in complex plant DNA mixtures, including processed botanical materials, herbal products, mock communities, and environmental samples.

researchAreas.title: Plant Sex Chromosome Evolution
researchAreas.summary: My doctoral work used comparative and population genomics to reconstruct repeated sex-determination transitions in willows, including an XY-to-ZW transition.

researchAreas.title: Hybridization and Diversification
researchAreas.summary: I study how ancient hybridization, chloroplast capture, and population history shape evolutionary conflict and diversification in willows, poplars, and relatives.

researchAreas.title: Open Botanical Workflows
researchAreas.summary: I build reusable workflows for genome assembly, annotation transfer, marker discovery, species-tree inference, and teaching computational population genetics.

projects.name: SPrOUT
projects.summary: A computational pipeline for predicting species taxonomic information from single and mixed plant samples using target sequencing arrays and Angiosperms353.

projects.name: HiCassembly
projects.summary: A practical workflow for plant genome assembly using long reads, polishing tools, Juicer, 3D-DNA, and Hi-C signal review.

projects.name: Homologous Annotation Pipeline
projects.summary: Annotation transfer and comparative genomics notes using Liftoff, GFF3 files, synteny plotting, synonymous sites, nonsynonymous sites, and dS calculations.

projects.name: SDR Mapping Project
projects.summary: Population genomic scripts for mapping sex-determination regions, including read mapping, variant calling, FST scans, phasing, and X/Y haplotype analysis.

projects.name: Target Sequencing Phylogenetics
projects.summary: Notes and workflow material for reconstructing species trees from gene trees using target sequencing data.

projects.name: Molecular Population Genetics 2021
projects.summary: Course materials for Advanced Molecular Population Genetics, including tutorials on HWE, variation, recombination, population structure, and selection.
